$description: Cinema's design language: near-black neutral surfaces, white type, one red action colour. Artwork supplies all the colour on screen. Authored once here, emitted to CSS custom properties (web), Swift (apps/ios) and Kotlin (apps/android) so the three clients cannot drift apart.

canvas.use: The page. Near-black, very slightly cool.

surface.use: Cards and inputs sitting on the canvas.

surface-3.use: Pressed, and borders that need to be seen.

border.use: Hairline. Almost never needed -- spacing separates things.

primary.use: The single action colour. Play, active nav marker, progress.

match.use: Community rating, the one positive signal.

amber.use: Status flags: new, popular, offline warnings.

overlay.use: Hover fill on a dark surface.

hairline.use: The only border in the system.
